items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear and the layout is tidy, but no public API (NewEncryptor, EncryptWriter, DecryptReader, LoadKey, Config) has a doc comment. Numbers are hardcoded: `nonce := make([]byte, 12)`, `if length < 28`, `chunkData[:12]`, `make([]byte, 32)`, `pbkdf2.Key(..., 10000, ...)`. Short names e/ew/dr.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: decryptReader.init is one ~85-line function covering header, chunk loop and HMAC. LoadKey repeats the same decode, length check and ErrInvalidKey wrap for every source. After cfg.Validate() it re-checks fields (`if cfg.KeyEnvVar == ""`), which can never trigger. The key-copy code is duplicated.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: init buffers the whole decrypted stream in a bytes.Buffer, so it doesn't stream and large DB dumps exhaust memory. `make([]byte, length)` has no upper bound, so up to 4GB per chunk. newEncryptWriter calls panic(err). PBKDF2 uses only 10000 iterations. Lenient multi-encoding base64 fallback. Errors are otherwise wrapped.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: Required signatures changed, callers updated, unencrypted output unchanged. storage.PathGenerator keeps its old signature and hardcodes `false`. Job.Validate now joins all errors instead of returning the first. save() returns nil when there are no storages, so the getDumper error is skipped. New YAML keys.
